mn21:3.2: “Sir, Venerable Phagguna of the Top-Knot is spending too long mixing closely with some nuns.
mn21:3.4: if any mendicant criticized those nuns in his presence, Phagguna of the Top-Knot got angry and upset, and even instigated disciplinary proceedings.
mn21:3.5: And if any mendicant criticized Phagguna of the Top-Knot in their presence, those nuns got angry and upset, and even instigated disciplinary proceedings.
mn21:3.6: That’s how close Venerable Phagguna of the Top-Knot is with those nuns, sir.”
